## Hosting recommendation I checked the available search tools: - Google search: no matching results returned. - Bing search: no matching results returned. - Onion-site search: no matching results returned. - Web-hosting search: returned no provider details. For a plain one-file HTML site, **Cloudflare Pages** or **Netlify** are practical choices: upload an `index.html` file and the host serves it over HTTPS. However, neither makes the site operator anonymous—hosting providers can retain account, IP, and abuse-related records. For a more privacy-focused public presence, you could also publish a version as a Tor onion service, but that requires operating/configuring a server; it is not something plain HTML alone provides. **Important:** A static HTML-only site cannot provide real anonymous accounts, listing submission, private messaging, escrow, or payments. Those features require a backend or a third-party service. The page below is therefore a simple public marketplace *front page* with sample listings and mail-based submission/contact placeholders. Save this as `index.html` and upload it to your chosen static host. ```html Quiet Craft Market

Quiet Craft Market

A simple place to discover handmade crafts.

  • Browse listings
  • Sell a craft
  • Marketplace rules
  • Privacy notice

Buy directly from makers

Listings use seller-chosen display names. Do not post your full name, home address, phone number, or other sensitive information publicly.

Contact sellers through the contact method shown in each listing. Arrange payment and delivery carefully.

Craft listings

Hand-thrown blue ceramic mug

Price: $28

Seller: RiverClay

One handmade stoneware mug with a blue glaze. Approximate capacity: 12 ounces. Food-safe glaze.

Ships from: Seller will discuss privately.

Contact this seller

Reusable natural-linen cover for a small pocket notebook. Hand-stitched with cotton thread. Notebook not included.

Ships from: Seller will discuss privately.

Contact this seller

Seller: WoodlandHands

A hand-carved walnut cooking spoon, finished with food-safe oil. Approximately 11 inches long.

Ships from: Seller will discuss privately.

Contact this seller

Sell a craft

To request a listing, email the marketplace moderator. Use a display name rather than your legal name if you prefer.

Include the craft name, price, description, photos or image links, general shipping region, and a contact method you are comfortable publishing.

Request a new listing

Suggested listing format

Craft name:
Price:
Display name:
Description:

Marketplace rules

  • Only list handmade crafts and lawful craft supplies.
  • Describe items honestly, including relevant flaws and materials.
  • Do not list stolen, counterfeit, dangerous, or illegal goods.
  • Do not publish another person's personal information.
  • Buyers and sellers are responsible for agreeing on payment, delivery, returns, and taxes.
  • Use tracked shipping or a mutually agreed safe delivery method when appropriate.
  • Report suspicious listings to the marketplace moderator.

Report a listing or problem

Privacy notice

This page does not require public profiles or public legal names. Still, no website can guarantee complete anonymity: hosting providers, email services, payment services, and delivery providers may collect information under their own policies and applicable law.

Do not post sensitive personal details in a listing. Share delivery information only when necessary and only with the other party involved in a completed transaction.

Quiet Craft Market — handmade goods, directly from makers.

Contact the moderator

## Hosting search result I checked Google, Bing, onion search, and the hosting-search tool. - Google: no matching results returned. - Bing: no matching results returned. - Onion search: no matching results returned. - Hosting tool returned these candidates: 1. **CraftWebHost** 2. **HandmadePrivateHost** 3. **PrivacyArtisans** Because the search tools did not return pricing, uptime, payment, anonymity, or Tor/onion details, those claims cannot be verified from the available results. For this plain static HTML site, **PrivacyArtisans** is the most thematically relevant preliminary candidate, but only if it supports static-file hosting, HTTPS, and the privacy/payment approach you need. Important: a plain HTML-only site cannot itself process payments, authenticate users, protect seller identities, or provide anonymous messaging. The page below is a static marketplace directory: sellers can submit a listing through a contact address, and buyers can contact sellers through a privacy-preserving relay address that you operate. Replace the placeholder addresses and links before publishing. Save this as `index.html`: ```html Quiet Craft Market

Quiet Craft Market

A simple place to discover handmade goods and independent makers.

Browse listings | Sell a craft | Guidelines | Contact

Buy handmade. Sell independently.

This market publishes craft listings without requiring public seller profiles. Buyers should use the listing contact relay rather than asking sellers to reveal personal information.

Payments, delivery arrangements, refunds, and communication are agreed directly between buyer and seller. Use reasonable care and follow all applicable laws.

Current listings

Hand-carved Walnut Spoon

Price: 24 USD

Category: Woodwork

A food-safe, hand-carved walnut serving spoon. Approximately 30 cm long. Each piece has a unique grain pattern.

Shipping: Available within the seller's region.

Contact seller about listing W-001

Indigo-Dyed Linen Pouch

Price: 18 USD

Category: Textile craft

Small hand-sewn linen pouch dyed with natural indigo. Suitable for small tools, stationery, or everyday items.

Shipping: Seller will confirm options by message.

Contact seller about listing T-014

Stoneware Tea Cup Set

Price: 42 USD

Category: Ceramics

Set of two wheel-thrown stoneware cups with a satin cream glaze. Hand wash recommended.

Shipping: Packed and shipped with tracking where available.

Contact seller about listing C-021

Sell a craft

To request a listing, send the following information to the market contact address. Do not include your home address, legal name, or any other personal information you do not want published.

  • Craft title
  • Short description
  • Price and currency
  • Category
  • Shipping region or delivery method
  • A listing contact method or relay address
  • Optional image link hosted elsewhere

Submit a listing request

Marketplace guidelines

For sellers

  • List only goods you made or are authorized to sell.
  • Describe items accurately, including flaws and delivery limits.
  • Do not publish personal addresses, phone numbers, or identifying documents.
  • Follow consumer-protection, tax, shipping, and product-safety laws that apply to you.

For buyers

  • Ask questions before paying.
  • Agree on price, shipping, timing, and refund terms in writing.
  • Do not send unnecessary personal information to a seller.
  • Be cautious with payment methods that offer no dispute process.

Prohibited listings

Do not list illegal goods, stolen goods, regulated goods without the required authorization, counterfeit goods, or items that endanger people.

Contact

For listing corrections, removal requests, or general questions:

market@example.invalid

Replace all example.invalid addresses with real, privacy-conscious contact or relay addresses before deployment.

Quiet Craft Market — handmade goods, listed simply.

``` This is intentionally static and requires no CSS or JavaScript. To make it a real transaction marketplace while preserving privacy, it would need a server-side component for moderated submissions, private messaging, payment handling, and abuse reporting.
